ownership.quote: We're excited to share that Lightpanda has raised a pre-seed round to build the first browser designed from the ground up for machines.

stage.quote: Lightpanda has raised a pre-seed round to build the first browser designed from the ground up for machines. The round is led by ISAI, with participation from a group of exceptional angel investors...
stage.note: Only one priced round found (pre-seed, June 2025), confirmed by the company blog and corroborated by Caplight's 'Last Round: Pre Seed, Jun 10, 2025'. No later round found as of check date.

last_round.quote: The round is led by ISAI, with participation from a group of exceptional angel investors including the founders of Mistral, Hugging Face and Dust.

revenue.basis: Third-party estimate cited by Startuply.vc, attributed to Prospeo (2025): 'Third-party estimates place the company's annual revenue at approximately $599k, with a valuation around $2 million'.
revenue.quote: Third-party estimates place the company's annual revenue at approximately $599k, with a valuation around $2 million [Prospeo, 2025].

note: Lightpanda is a Paris-based startup founded 2022 by CEO Francis Bouvier (previously co-founded BlueBoard, acquired by ChannelAdvisor in 2020), CTO Pierre Tachoire, and COO Katie Hallett/Brown. It builds an open-source (not company-owned foundation) headless browser engine written in Zig, aimed at AI agents/automation, and monetizes via a managed cloud product (the 'lightpanda' card here). Only one funding round (pre-seed, June 2025, undisclosed amount) is confirmed; no priced Seed/Series A found as of 2026-09-30. Not a Y Combinator or other named-accelerator company per available sources.
